Name: MagicScepter
Author: not4bene
Description:
This mod makes your Scepter more worthy its price allowing you to teleport around when you meet certain conditions. See [b][i]How to use[/i] [/b]section.

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to use[/b][/size]
Just use Scepter as you normally do. Scepter gains more power when you meet certain [b]requirements[/b] (check list of them below). If you don't meet them Scepter will behave like normal one and teleport you to farm's door.

[size=4][b]Configuration menu
[/b][/size]
There is a configuration menu where you can adjust order, visibility, change name or add keybind to teleport scrolls. Configuration will be saved withing your save file, so different configuration on different characters are possible. 
Open configuration menu by clicking a cogwheel icon next to scroll label.


[b][size=4]Keybindings[/size][/b][b]

[/b]You can add keybinds to your favourite scrolls. Use keybind menu in configuration to bind you favourite teleport places and then after using Scepter and opening teleport menu just hit the key binded to it!


[b][size=4]Old dialog menu[/size][/b]
﻿If you want to use old dialog menu change it in the [b]Settings menu[/b] or set [b]UseOldDialogMenu [/b]to [b]true  [/b]in [u]config.json[/u]:

[code]﻿{
﻿"UseOldDialogMenu": true
}
[/code]
[size=4][b]Memory mode[/b][/size]
This option allows scepter to remember scrolls you used so you no longer need to keep requirements for it to work.
Example: build Beach Obelisk on farm, then use teleport scroll once so magic scepter gains its power. Then you can destroy that obelisk but still use its teleport feature using scepter.
Can be set it in the [b]Settings menu[/b] or set [b]MemodryMode[/b] to [b]true [/b]in [u]config.json[/u]:

[code]﻿{
﻿"MemoryMode": true
}
[/code]
